name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, and ZAR by carry-to-volatility ratio. Carry = 3-month interbank rate minus US Fed Funds. Vol = 21-day annualized realized FX volatility. Outputs: cross-sectional bar chart (current ranking), time series of carry-to-vol evolution, and summary table with key stats.
source:
# EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# Carry = 3M interbank rate - US Fed Funds
# Vol = 21-day annualized realized FX vol
# Carry-to-Vol = carry / vol (higher = more attractive carry per unit risk)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# US Fed Funds rate (daily, in %)
us_rate = ffill(common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)().result)

# EM 3-month interbank rates (monthly FRED, in %)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')().result
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')().result
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')().result

# Forward-fill monthly rates to daily
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw)

# --- Asset routing: assign correct EM rate to each FX pair ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')().result
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')().result
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDZAR')().result

# Each asset gets its own EM rate
em_rate = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_rate, is_mxn, mxn_rate, is_zar, zar_rate, 0.0)

# --- Carry = EM rate - US rate (both in %) ---
carry = em_rate - us_rate

# --- Realized Vol (21-day, annualized decimal) ---
# volatility() expects price levels, outputs annualized decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%)
vol_21d = volatility(period=21)(close)

# Convert vol to % for consistent units with carry (which is in %)
vol_pct = vol_21d * 100.0

# --- Carry-to-Vol ratio ---
# carry is in %, vol_pct is in % → ratio is unitless
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(vol_pct) and vol_pct > 0.0, carry / vol_pct)

# --- Output 1: Current Ranking (bar chart) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Which EM Currency Offers the Best Carry per Unit Risk?',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Ratio',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    data_labels=True,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Blue, Color.Blue],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 2: Time Series Evolution ---
cs_lines(
    title='How Has the Carry-to-Vol Ranking Evolved?',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Ratio',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Emerald],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Components & Stats',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Carry-to-Vol Components & Stats',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='EM Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='US Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='21d Vol (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry/Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(em_rate, us_rate, carry, vol_pct, carry_to_vol)
